messages:
incident-bot: [P1] us-west error spike: 5xx rate 14% over 4m, paging @oncall
maya: i'm awake. seeing increased 502/504s from embeddings and generate in us-west. paging team. anyone on-call?
sam: oncall here, digging in. checking autoscaler and pool saturation. can someone check proxy logs for recent deploys?
lee: i see a router-config deploy ~22m ago that reduced max connections per upstream. pulling diffs now.
maya: @anya can you triage customer impact? @kira FYI in case support needs faster comms.
anya: support: hitting errors for acquila-inc (prod-us-west) and a couple of smaller tenants. opening tickets, adding affected list here.
sam: manual mitigations: increasing dedicated pool target by 30% for us-west and restarting a few overloaded gateway pods. pushing now.
lee: initiating rollback of router-config to prior stable (rollback id: router-config-2026-03-14-18:22). deploy-bot triggered.
deploy-bot: rollback started -> router-config back to stable-20260314
ops-bot: enabling temporary routing fallback: route up to 25% of non-sensitive us-west traffic to eu-west while we stabilize.
sam: after scale + pod restarts latency down ~25%, error rate dropping from 14% -> 4.8% in last 5m. still above baseline.
maya: good. i'm taking incident lead. state handoffs when you leave @sam.
sam: handing to @lee in 8m. mitigation summary: scale + rollback + fallback routing. still seeing occasional 502s on long-context embeddings.
lee: watching. one gateway (gw-usw-3) shows connection saturation and 5xx bursts. probable upstream backpressure from proxy change.
anya: customer impact summary: acquila-inc saw 21 failed embedding requests in last 20m; retries succeeded for many. notifying customer with status update.
maya: we need to avoid noisy pages during these transient bursts. current alert fired on error_rate_5xx > 5% for 3m which caused pages during deploy windows.
lee: suggestion: move to composite alerting that requires both sustained error rate and latency. and add deploy suppression for brief windows.
sam: proposed alert (templated):

```
alert "regional_error_and_latency" {
  expr = (region:error_5xx_rate:avg_over_time[5m] > 0.06) and (region:p95_latency:avg_over_time[3m] > 0.7)
  for 5m
  annotations = { summary = "{{ $labels.region }} elevated errors + latency" }
}
```

maya: also: add a deploy-suppression rule: if a deploy event occurred in region within last 10m, suppress paging if error rate < 12% and gradual fallback is in progress.
lee: i'll add a new dashboard panel "regional-health + failover" with per-region: error_rate, p50/p95 latency, routing_shift_pct, pool_capacity, gateway_conn_rate, failover_status, and active tickets count. will include a synthetic monitor for embeddings with long-context every 30s in us-west.
anya: support wants a runbook widget showing affected customers, ticket links, and fallback status. add a short link in the dashboard to create customer comms.
sam: i'll open a PR that includes: alert rules, suppression logic, new dashboard JSON, and rollout plan. will add notes about cooldown and backstop thresholds.
lee: also recommend internal (no-page) anomaly alert: gateway_conn_rate zscore > 4 for 2m -> inform SRE channel so we can pre-scale before customer impact.
maya: action items: 
- sam: PR with alerts + dashboard + rollout instructions (due: today EOD).
- lee: update runbook with routing fallback play and deploy suppression toggle (due: tomorrow AM).
- anya: customer comms template and affected-customer list + postmortem blurb (due: tomorrow AM).
- infra: add metric for per-gateway connection pool saturation and expose to dashboard.

sam: current numbers: errors down to 0.9% after rollback+scale+fallback. customer errors trending to zero. monitoring for 60m then transition to post-incident cleanup.
maya: nice work. tagging #postmortems for formal incident document. leave followups in owners above. incident-bot: mark mitigated when stable. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated
maya: handoff note: last_message_ts=2381123860. leaving follow-ups to owners listed. ping if regressions.
